title: Canonical suite — v9-agentic (sft12, K-FAC Q6_K) against its parent and v7-coder
basis: The v9-agentic column is one run of the K-FAC Q6_K (sha 56cc506911569bb1) on pod 60948837 (two RTX 3090, 2026-11-16 19:16Z → 2026-11-17 03:59Z): llama.cpp b12386 (+ the PEG-degrade patch), `--parallel 2`, greedy decoding with `presence_penalty 0.025` and no repetition penalty (the model's deployment profile, sampler `greedy_pres`), thinking on with the templates' budgets, scores read from each bench's `summary.json`. The 128e and v7-coder columns are the cells carried on this model line's cards since the first v9-agentic release: each model on its own Q6_K, greedy, llama.cpp b9700, their own samplers (see the weights card for the per-model sampler and loop counts). Same prompts and scorers; the sampler and server build differ across columns, so read gaps of a few points as basis, not model.
notes: Metrics: GPQA & GSM8K = `exact_match` flexible-extract · MATH500 = `math_verify` · ARC & AIME = `exact_match` · IFEval = `prompt_level_strict_acc` · HumanEval/+ = `pass@1` chat-extract · LCB & MultiPL-E = `pass@1` · tool-eval-bench = mean Total Points over seeds 42–46 (95 % CI 141.2–144.0; per seed 143 / 141 / 144 / 143 / 142), scorer 2.6.0, `--hardmode --weight-by-difficulty`, 64k context, pressure 0.25, on the **K-FAC Q4_K_M** with greedy + `presence_penalty 0.035`, stock llama.cpp b12386 on an RTX PRO 6000; 6th of 12 in the in-house 64k cohort (omnimerge-v6 156.4, qwen3.8-27b 150.8, ornith-1.5-35b 146.2, omnimerge-v4 146.2, qwen3.6-27b 144.0, **this build 142.6**, qwen3.6-35b-a3b 141.6, previous v9-agentic build 137.6, a3b-coderx 137.4, ornith-27b-coder 136.8, ornith-27b-coderx 134.0, a3b-coder 123.2); the parent and v7-coder have no cell in that cohort. Empty cell = not run for this build. Raw `summary.json` / samples of the v9-agentic column: `google/v9a_sft11/mlk8-noa-sft12/pod_q6k_kfac_eval/`; tool-eval-bench reports: `omnimergekit/eval/toolbench/cohort64k_v9sft12/`.
